cause: Scheduled collector cadence not realized; scheduler root cause unknown. Incomplete worker coverage remains unexplained.
hypothesis: Missing scheduled workflow executions rather than failure inside a started collector explains current stale snapshot.

test.method: Read main workflow and watchdog source; query 100 main-branch CI runs, filter collector; compare expected cron slots with actual run creation and health snapshot.
test.result: Confirmed missing visible runs after last successful one. Scheduled path explicitly uses --once; push path uses five cycles. No evidence of a failed started collector in this interval; underlying scheduling cause unknown. Workflow metadata endpoint returned HTTP 400, branch-filtered runs endpoint succeeded.

next_test.acceptance: More than 3 persisted finals, at least one beyond entry page, diagnosis persisted, quote age <=900s for any BUY; verify actual collector cadence. Investigate isolated bounded collector recovery mechanism if no new run; no main deployment.
